Shared-memory txn cache layout and init/join function prototypes.

# Purpose
This header file declares the shared-memory interface for the transaction cache used by the Flamenco runtime. It defines the required alignment and a magic value for the shared-memory region, and it declares the opaque `fd_txncache_shmem_t` type and the `fd_txncache_fork_id_t` wrapper type. The file also declares functions to query the alignment and memory footprint, create a new shared-memory instance with [`fd_txncache_shmem_new`](<#fd_txncache_shmem_new>), and attach to an existing instance with [`fd_txncache_shmem_join`](<#fd_txncache_shmem_join>).
# Function Declarations (Public API)

---
- `fd_txncache_shmem_align`
- `fd_txncache_shmem_footprint`
- `fd_txncache_shmem_new`
- `fd_txncache_shmem_join`
